verdict.rationale: CAM is a law firm, not a software product, but it states it uses AI/ML legaltech, including AI contract review, in its day-to-day practice. Asking whether client data is kept out of AI training is therefore a fair question. The evidence pack has no policy, opt-out mechanism or commitment about excluding client data from AI model training, and its data-privacy material concerns advisory services and DPDP commentary rather than the firm's own handling of client data.
